name: BTP 3D wing geometry generator
type: Parametric geometry model, not a newly trained 3D neural model
input_geometry: Generated 2D source-native CST airfoil design.json files at root and optionally tip
coordinate_frame: x aft, y span, z up; horizontal projected span; twist about section quarter chord
training: No 3D training performed: current dataset contains 2D section labels only
requirements_scope: Geometric dimensions only; no proof of lift, drag, payload or flight requirements
units: Internal and OBJ metres; STL numeric coordinates millimetres (STL does not embed units)
